intro.title: A consulting partner, not just a vendor.
intro.body: Smart Land was founded in 2011 to deliver custom software for organizations that needed more than off-the-shelf tools. Fourteen years later, our portfolio spans sign-language translation, e-commerce, remote learning, and hospital management — with AI woven into each one.

about.title: About Smart Land
about.lead: A consulting and technology firm building custom software and AI solutions since 2011.
about.story1: Smart Land was founded in Damascus in 2011 with a simple premise: organizations deserve software built around their actual work, not forced into generic tools.
about.story2: Over fourteen years we've grown from a small consultancy into a multi-product company, shipping accessibility tools, e-commerce platforms, learning systems, and healthcare software — with AI integrated into every layer.
about.timeline2019: MyKey launches — sign-language translation at scale.
about.timeline2023: AI integrated across the full product portfolio.
about.pWelcome: Remote learning platform with live sessions.

projectsPage.title: Projects
projectsPage.lead: Six products shipped since 2011. Three of them carry the story of where we're going.
projectsPage.mykeyBody: MyKey turns spoken audio into real-time sign-language animation, giving deaf and hard-of-hearing users access to conversations, lectures, and public services that were never designed for them.
projectsPage.mykeyPoint3: Embedded into kiosks, classrooms, and broadcasts
projectsPage.sadaBody: Sada is a multi-store e-commerce platform where sellers launch, brand, and manage their own storefronts on shared infrastructure — payments, logistics, and analytics included.
projectsPage.signalBody: Smart Signal is a marketplace for properties and vehicles with listing tools, advanced search, rental workflows, and agent dashboards.
projectsPage.signalPoint1: Property and vehicle listings with rich media
projectsPage.signalPoint2: Advanced search by location, price, and type
projectsPage.signalPoint3: Rental and sale workflows with agent tools
